audit_items.skip_reason: KZG cryptographic validation (verify_cell_kzg_proof_batch_impl, commitment_indices bounds checking) is implemented in external library kzg4844. Nimbus code in peerdas_helpers.nim:386-403 acts as a caller wrapper that passes data to verifyCellKzgProofBatch from the external library. The actual bounds checking and validation logic is not implemented in this codebase.

Remote crash via malicious P2P commitment_indices depends on bounds validation in external kzg4844 library. Nimbus gossip_validation.nim:586-714 validates structural properties but delegates KZG cryptographic validation to external library.

Memory safety of out-of-bounds commitment_indices access in verify_cell_kzg_proof_batch_impl is determined by external kzg4844 library implementation (likely Rust or C via FFI). Nim's memory safety model applies to Nimbus wrapper code only.

Array length validation partially in scope. Nimbus verifies array length consistency in verify_data_column_sidecar (peerdas_helpers.nim:362-364) but does not explicitly validate len(commitment_bytes) == len(cell_indices) == len(cells) == len(proofs_bytes) before calling verifyCellKzgProofBatch.

audit_finding.phase1_analysis: verify_data_column_sidecar checks: sidecar.column.len == sidecar.kzg_commitments.len == sidecar.kzg_proofs.len (line 362-364). This provides array length consistency validation before KZG proof verification.
audit_finding.phase2_verification: PARTIAL - Nimbus validates array lengths match via SSZ list constraints and explicit check at line 362-364. However, individual element byte lengths (BYTES_PER_COMMITMENT, BYTES_PER_CELL, BYTES_PER_PROOF) are validated by the external kzg4844 library during deserialization.
audit_finding.phase3_classification: MITIGATED - The array length equality check in verify_data_column_sidecar provides defense-in-depth before calling verifyCellKzgProofBatch. The external library should also validate, but Nimbus does not assume this.

audit_items.skip_reason: P2P gossip validation layer check. Nimbus validateDataColumnSidecar (gossip_validation.nim:586-714) calls verify_data_column_sidecar before check_data_column_sidecar_kzg_proofs, providing defense-in-depth.

audit_finding.phase1_analysis: validateDataColumnSidecar performs multiple validation checks in order: verify_data_column_sidecar (structural), subnet validation, slot validation, inclusion proof, parent validation, proposer validation, signature validation, then KZG proof validation. This follows defense-in-depth principle.
audit_finding.phase2_verification: CONFIRMED - P2P gossip validation enforces equal-length constraint via verify_data_column_sidecar check at line 596-598 before reaching verifyCellKzgProofBatch at line 700-703.
audit_finding.phase3_classification: MITIGATED - Defense-in-depth is implemented. Malformed data is rejected early in the validation pipeline.

audit_items.skip_reason: Remote crash vulnerability assessment depends on external kzg4844 library's handling of mismatched array lengths. Nimbus code validates lengths match before calling, but crash behavior is library-dependent.
Validation order within verify_cell_kzg_proof_batch (length check before cryptographic operations) is determined by external kzg4844 library implementation.

cell_index bounds validation (cell_index < CELLS_PER_EXT_BLOB) before coset_for_cell/coset_shift_for_cell is implemented in external kzg4844 library. Nimbus passes CellIndex(sidecar.index) to verifyCellKzgProofBatch.

audit_items.skip_reason: P2P gossip validation of cell_index bounds. Nimbus verify_data_column_sidecar checks sidecar.index >= NUMBER_OF_COLUMNS (line 356-357), but NUMBER_OF_COLUMNS=128 and CELLS_PER_EXT_BLOB=128 per spec.

audit_finding.phase1_analysis: verify_data_column_sidecar rejects if sidecar.index >= NUMBER_OF_COLUMNS (128). Since CELLS_PER_EXT_BLOB = 128 and NUMBER_OF_COLUMNS = 128 per the spec (fulu.nim:49,57), this bounds check is equivalent to cell_index < CELLS_PER_EXT_BLOB.
audit_finding.phase2_verification: CONFIRMED - Line 356-357 validates sidecar.index < NUMBER_OF_COLUMNS before any further processing. This provides P2P layer defense.
audit_finding.phase3_classification: MITIGATED - Nimbus validates column/cell index bounds at P2P gossip layer.

audit_items.skip_reason: Remote crash via out-of-bounds cell_index depends on kzg4844 library's bounds checking in coset_for_cell. Nimbus validates index < NUMBER_OF_COLUMNS at P2P layer.
cell_index bounds validation order within verify_cell_kzg_proof_batch before calling coset_for_cell/coset_shift_for_cell is kzg4844 library implementation detail.
Integer overflow in FIELD_ELEMENTS_PER_CELL * cell_index is kzg4844 library implementation detail. Nimbus does not perform this multiplication.
Byte length validation for commitment_bytes, cell, proof_bytes. SSZ serialization in Nim enforces fixed-size types. Actual byte length validation during KZG operations is in external library.

code_scope.note: Type definitions: BYTES_PER_CELL = 2048, Cell = KzgCell (from kzg4844)

audit_finding.phase1_analysis: Nimbus uses SSZ for serialization which enforces type constraints. KzgCell, KzgCommitment, KzgProof are fixed-size types from kzg4844. SSZ deserialization would fail if byte lengths don't match expected sizes.
audit_finding.phase2_verification: PARTIAL - SSZ provides type-level enforcement. Actual validation at deserialization time depends on SSZ implementation and kzg4844 type definitions.
audit_finding.phase3_classification: MITIGATED at type level by SSZ fixed-size constraints.

audit_items.skip_reason: commitment_bytes length validation during KZG deserialization to G1 point is kzg4844 library responsibility. SSZ enforces KzgCommitment is 48 bytes.
cell byte length validation is kzg4844 library responsibility. SSZ enforces KzgCell is 2048 bytes (BYTES_PER_CELL).
proof_bytes length validation during KZG deserialization is kzg4844 library responsibility. SSZ enforces KzgProof is 48 bytes.
Array length consistency for batch operations. Nimbus verify_data_column_sidecar validates sidecar.column.len == sidecar.kzg_commitments.len == sidecar.kzg_proofs.len.

audit_finding.phase1_analysis: verify_data_column_sidecar explicitly checks: sidecar.column.len != sidecar.kzg_commitments.len or sidecar.column.len != sidecar.kzg_proofs.len returns error.
audit_finding.phase2_verification: CONFIRMED - Lines 362-364 enforce array length consistency before KZG proof verification.
audit_finding.phase3_classification: MITIGATED - Nimbus validates array lengths match at P2P gossip layer.

audit_items.skip_reason: P2P gossip validation layer byte length enforcement via SSZ schema. DataColumnSidecar SSZ schema enforces fixed-size types for KzgCommitment, KzgCell, KzgProof.

audit_finding.phase1_analysis: DataColumnSidecar type uses KzgCommitments, DataColumn (List[KzgCell]), KzgProofs which are SSZ-serialized with fixed-size elements. SSZ deserialization enforces byte lengths.
audit_finding.phase2_verification: CONFIRMED - SSZ schema at type definition level enforces byte length constraints. Malformed P2P messages would fail SSZ deserialization before reaching validation functions.
audit_finding.phase3_classification: MITIGATED - Defense-in-depth via SSZ type constraints at deserialization layer.

audit_finding.phase2_verification: CONFIRMED - Nimbus rejects DataColumnSidecar if KZG proof verification fails, preventing propagation of invalid data.
audit_finding.phase3_classification: MITIGATED - Invalid proofs are rejected at validation layer, preventing consensus impact.

audit_finding.phase3_classification: DESIGN CONSIDERATION - Verification should use commitment from trusted consensus state, not from the sidecar being validated. Need to trace full call chain.
